title: SDUI Screen Contract
description: Platform-neutral Server-Driven UI contract. A single JSON drives both SwiftUI (iOS) and Compose (Android) renderers. Nothing here is specific to any platform: 'vstack' maps to VStack / Column, tokens resolve from a shared design-token file. This schema is the single source of truth — Swift and Kotlin models are generated from it, and it validates payloads BEFORE they ever reach a renderer.

version.description: Contract version this payload targets, e.g. '0.1'. Renderers reject payloads whose major version they do not understand.

Screen.description: A full screen: its data dependencies, its content tree, and screen-level lifecycle hooks.

id.description: Stable screen identifier. Used for navigation targets, deep links and analytics.

title.description: Navigation-bar title. May be a binding, e.g. '$data.product.title'.

state.description: Local, client-only state initialised when the screen appears. Keys are referenced as '$state.<key>'. Values are literals used as defaults.

onAppear.description: Action run once the screen becomes visible (analytics, prefetch, etc.).

refresh.description: Pull-to-refresh behaviour. If present, the renderer attaches a refresh control that re-runs the named data sources.

sources.description: IDs of data sources to reload. Empty = reload all.

chrome.description: How the host frames the screen. 'immersive' = edge-to-edge, no nav bar, fixed theme (the screen draws its own background/chrome).

teach.description: An interactive-teaching coach prompt — a dismissible 'try this' card that onboards a newcomer with one concrete action and an instant result.

title.description: What this screen demonstrates, in a few words.

task.description: A micro-task the user can do right now for an immediate change.

ScrollBehavior.description: Scroll-reactive header for the whole screen: a large title (derived from the screen 'title') that shrinks and pins as you scroll, cross-fading into the nav bar, plus optional pull-to-reveal search. Set once per screen; the engine gives every scroll the same Apple-grade behaviour.

largeTitle.description: Show the collapsing large title. Default true; false = a plain inline title.

subtitle.description: Optional one-line subtitle under the large title.

minScale.description: How small the title shrinks before handing off to the nav bar, as a fraction of full size. Default 0.62.

range.description: Scroll distance (pt) over which the collapse completes. Default derived from the title height.

pinTitle.description: Cross-fade a compact title into the nav bar after collapse. Default true.

revealOnPull.description: Telegram-style search hidden above the title, revealed by pulling down at the top.

bind.description: A '$state.<key>' the query is written to, so content can filter live.

threshold.description: Pull distance (pt) past the top that latches the field open. Default 52.

Component.description: A node in the view tree. The 'type' field is the discriminator. Unknown types beginning with 'custom.' are passed to the host app's component registry; all other unknown types are a validation error.

id.description: Optional stable id. Required for scroll-to targets and diffed list items.

visibleWhen.description: If present and false, the node (and subtree) is not rendered.

PagerProps.description: A paging carousel: shows one child page at a time with page dots and optional auto-advance — the premium rotating-hero-banner pattern. Manual swipe always works; auto-advance pauses under Reduce Motion.

children.description: The pages, one shown at a time.

height.description: Page height in points (the carousel doesn't size to content).

autoAdvanceMs.description: Auto-advance interval in milliseconds; 0 (default) = manual paging only. 4000–7000 is the premium range.

DatePickerProps.description: A native date picker two-way bound to a $state key holding an ISO yyyy-MM-dd string. Each platform renders its own native calendar from the same contract.

bind.description: State key holding the selected date (yyyy-MM-dd).

style.description: Full month calendar or a compact field.

CalendarProps.description: A custom month-grid calendar. The same node does single-day, contiguous range, or multi-day selection via the bindable `mode`. All dates are ISO yyyy-MM-dd strings in $state; range uses two keys, multi uses one comma-separated key. Maps 1:1 to Compose/Aurora (pure layout + state maths).

mode.description: 'single' | 'range' | 'multi'. Bindable so chips can switch it live.

bind.description: State key for the single-day selection (yyyy-MM-dd).

startBind.description: Range start state key (yyyy-MM-dd, may be empty).

endBind.description: Range end state key (yyyy-MM-dd, may be empty).

multiBind.description: Multi-select state key: comma-separated yyyy-MM-dd list.

ClipsProps.description: A full-screen vertical snap-pager — an Instagram Reels / TikTok feed. Swipe up/down to page, double-tap to like. Each page carries its own media, caption and action-rail counts. Maps to a Compose VerticalPager / Aurora scroll-snap container.

pages.description: The feed. Each page is one full-screen clip.

colors.description: Gradient stops for the media backdrop (stand-in for a video/photo URL).

FileCellProps.description: A document/upload cell: pick a file from the system Files app, then show its format, icon and size. Handles empty / success / error (over max size) states.

maxSizeKB.description: Reject files larger than this and show an inline error.

TickerProps.description: An invisible clock that advances a numeric $state value on an interval (a playing progress bar, stopwatch, live counter). Writes through the same two-way binding a slider reads.

loop.description: Reset to 0 when it reaches max (default false).

while.description: Bool state key — ticks only while true.

DisclosureProps.description: A collapsible section: a tappable header (title, optional subtitle and icon) that reveals or hides its children with a spring. Self-contained — no state binding needed. Its `children` render only while open.

RoadmapProps.description: A numbered vertical roadmap / timeline; steps with a detail expand like sections on tap.

SliderProps.description: A draggable continuous control (0…1), two-way bound to screen state.

bind.description: State key it reads and writes (0…1).

AsyncProps.description: Fetch-then-render container: loads one data source, showing a loading slot while in flight, then the content slot with the response bound as $data.<source.id> (or the error slot on failure).

source.description: The data source to load. Its id becomes the $data key inside content.

loading.description: Shown while fetching. Defaults to a centred spinner.

error.description: Shown on failure. Defaults to a recoverable message.

style.description: Series style. Rendered natively (Swift Charts on iOS).

values.description: Y values plotted against their index. Use this OR 'points'.

colors.description: Two or more stops: hex or '$token.color.*'.

values.description: Progress per ring, 0…1, outermost first (Apple Fitness idiom).

gap.description: Space between rings in points. Default 6.

spacing.description: Gap between children. Token ref like '$token.spacing.md' or a number in points.

alignment.description: Cross-axis alignment. Baseline options align text of mixed sizes (e.g. a big number next to a small unit).

lazy.description: When this stack is the immediate child of a same-axis 'scroll', its rows render lazily (on demand) for smooth scrolling on long content — the default. Set false to force eager rendering (build all rows up front).

collapsingHeader.description: Apple-Weather-style collapsing hero: 'expanded' fades/shrinks as you scroll over 'range' points while 'compact' pins to the top on a material bar.

range.description: Scroll distance (points) over which the collapse completes. Default 150.

onReachEnd.description: Fired when the user scrolls near the end — used to drive pagination.

ListProps.description: Lazy, virtualised list. Either provide static 'children', or bind 'items' to an array and provide an item 'template'.

items.description: Binding to a data array, e.g. '$data.feed.items'. Each element is exposed as '$item' inside the template.

empty.description: Rendered instead of any rows when the filtered result is empty — the no-results state (SF Symbol + message + a clear-filters button). Shown live as search/filters narrow to nothing.

resultCount.description: A '$state.<key>' the filtered-total (before pagination) is mirrored into, so the contract can show a live count ('128 people') and drive the empty state. Written whenever the count changes.

filter.description: Live filtering. A text 'query' over 'fields', an exact 'equals' category match, and a numeric 'min'/'max' range — every value bindable to $state so a search box, chips and range inputs narrow the same list without a round-trip.

fields.description: Item fields the query matches against (case-insensitive contains).

equals.description: Keep only items whose 'field' equals 'value'. A value of '' or 'all' matches everything.

min.description: Keep only items whose numeric 'field' is >= 'value' (ignored when 0/empty).

max.description: Keep only items whose numeric 'field' is <= 'value' (ignored when 0/empty).

sort.description: Sort the (filtered) items by a field, numeric when both sides parse else lexical.

by.description: Item field to sort on (bindable to $state so a control can switch it).

limit.description: Show only the first N rows. A literal number or a $state.<key> binding — pair with pagination to grow the cursor and reveal more.

reorder.description: When true and 'items' binds to a $state.<key> array, rows can be dragged to reorder; the new order is written back to that state key.

paginateOnScroll.description: Infinite scroll: reaching the last row auto-loads the next page (shows a shimmer footer, waits 'loadDelay', then fires 'onReachEnd' — or, if none, increments the $state key behind 'limit' by 6). Defaults to true whenever 'limit' binds to $state; set false to keep a manual load-more control.

loadDelay.description: Seconds the shimmer footer lingers before the next page appears, so the load reads as real work rather than an instant jump. Default 0.6.

onReachEnd.description: Pagination hook fired when the last row appears. With paginateOnScroll it runs after the shimmer delay; without it, it fires immediately.

value.description: Text content. May be literal or a binding like '$data.user.name'.

source.description: Remote URL binding or a bundled asset name prefixed with 'asset:'.

loader.description: Async loading behaviour for remote images.

aspectRatio.description: width / height; reserves layout space so the list does not jump while loading.

GridProps.description: Lazy grid. Provide static 'children', or bind 'items' to an array and supply a 'template'.

size.description: Point size of the symbol. Defaults to the surrounding text size.

TextFieldProps.description: Single-line text input, two-way bound to screen state.

bind.description: State key to read/write, e.g. 'email' or '$state.email'.

helper.description: Helper / validation text shown below the field; coloured by status.

icon.description: Leading glyph name (SF Symbol on iOS; mapped per platform).

status.description: Explicit visual state. Absent = a normal focus-aware field. 'error'/'success' tint the border, helper and a trailing glyph; 'disabled' dims and blocks editing.

ProgressProps.description: Linear progress. Provide 'value' (0..1, may be a binding) for a determinate bar, or omit for an indeterminate spinner.

bind.description: State key holding the selected option value.

Modifiers.description: Platform-neutral visual modifiers applied to any component. Renderers translate each key to native equivalents.

material.description: Translucent system material behind the node. 'ultraThin'…'thick' are the four native blur tiers, 'bar' matches the toolbar material, and 'glass' is the visionOS-style frosted pane (material + hairline gradient stroke). Renders natively on iOS/Android/Aurora.

blur.description: Gaussian blur radius (points) applied to the node itself — distinct from 'material', which frosts what is behind the node. e.g. a blurred hero image behind a sheet. 0 = no blur.

scale.description: Uniform scale — a number or a $state binding. Pair with animation for a spring scale on state change.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees — a constant or a $state binding. Pairs with 'animation' for a spinning / flipping element.

pulse.description: A rhythmic auto-reversing scale 'heartbeat' — a bool $state key (pulses while true) or an object { while, scale, interval }. e.g. album art beating to music, or a live dot.

zoomable.description: Make the element interactively pinch-to-zoom, two-finger-rotate and drag, double-tap to reset — a photo-viewer gesture from one flag.

presentWhen.description: Present this subtree as a modal when the given bool $state key is true. It shares the screen's state, so a filter sheet drives the same list.

ignoresSafeArea.description: Extend this node under the safe area (edge-to-edge) — for immersive backgrounds.

size.description: Explicit, platform-neutral sizing per axis. Prefer this over 'frame' — it lays out identically on iOS and Android instead of relying on platform defaults.

accessibility.description: Accessibility metadata. Explicit because a control read as a button by VoiceOver is not automatically labelled for TalkBack.

onTap.description: Tap gesture on the whole component.

onDoubleTap.description: Double-tap gesture on the whole component (e.g. like-to-favourite).

hitSlop.description: Extra invisible tap padding (points) so small controls stay comfortably tappable.

onLongPress.description: Long-press gesture; commonly opens a context menu.

swipe.description: Swipe-to-reveal actions. 'leading' reveals on a left-to-right swipe, 'trailing' on a right-to-left swipe.

animation.description: Animation applied when this node's inputs change.

DataConfig.description: Declarative networking. Sources are fetched by the runtime and exposed under '$data.<id>'. Execution mode controls parallelism so both platforms behave identically.

mode.description: 'parallel' fetches all sources concurrently (async let / TaskGroup on iOS, coroutine async on Android). 'sequential' awaits them in order — use when one request depends on another.

DataSource.description: A single network request described declaratively. The host app maps 'service' to a base URL / auth, so payloads never hardcode hostnames.

service.description: Logical service name resolved by the host to a base URL + auth, e.g. 'catalog'.

path.description: Path template; '{param}' segments are filled from 'params' or bindings.

query.description: Query items; values may be bindings.

body.description: Request body for write methods. Object values may contain bindings.

dependsOn.description: IDs that must resolve first; forces ordering even in parallel mode.

Action.description: A declarative action triggered by an event. Actions compose: 'sequence' and 'parallel' wrap child actions. This is a closed vocabulary so both platforms interpret it identically.

action.description: Action kind. Kept in lockstep with the engines' ActionInterpreter — every kind here is one a client accepts. See spec/docs/authoring.md for each kind's field set.

analytics.description: Optional analytics event emitted when this action fires.

to.description: Target screen id or a route path.

Condition.description: Boolean expression over bindings. Exactly one operator key is expected.

BindableString.description: A string that is either a literal, or a binding expression starting with '$'. Namespaces: $data.<source>.<path>, $token.<group>.<name>, $env.<key> (locale, theme, platform...), $state.<key>, $params.<key> (navigation parameters passed to this screen), $item.<path> (inside list templates). Interpolation is allowed: 'Hello, $data.user.name'.

AxisSize.description: Sizing along one axis. 'fixed' = exact points (needs 'value'); 'hug' = size to content; 'fill' = take all available space; 'weight' = share available space proportionally (needs 'value').

tint.description: Button colour; defaults by role (destructive = red).

Dimension.description: A length in points (number) or a spacing/size token ref (string like '$token.spacing.md').

Color.description: A design token ref ('$token.color.primary'), a hex string ('#RRGGBB' / '#RRGGBBAA'), or a binding.

EdgeInsets.description: Either a single value applied to all edges, or per-edge values.
